description: This PHP source file defines the BearerTokenValidator class within the OrangeHRM OAuth server plugin. The class implements methods to validate OAuth2 bearer tokens in incoming HTTP requests, including mechanisms for token decryption, expiration, and revocation checks.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating OAuth2 bearer tokens within incoming HTTP requests, implementing token decryption, expiration, and revocation checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with an access token repository and an encryption key.

methods.name: validateAuthorization
methods.description: Validates the authorization header in the HTTP request, decrypts the token, verifies its validity, checks for revocation and expiration, and returns the modified request with the token attribute if successful.
